description: Replace who a track is billed to: the "Artist & Guest feat. Guest" line on every store. Send the whole list in billing order, as the artist tells you, with at least one `primary`. Nobody is added for you: the account's own artist is on the list only if you send it, so ask, and Send refuses a song with no primary artist. `primary` and `with` make up the main credit; `featured` and `remixer` become the "feat." part. A `primary` artist besides the account's own is a collaboration: ask the artist whether they have all the rights needed for it, and send rights_confirmed: true only when they say yes. Without it the call is refused and nothing is written. A song billing two or more names also needs each credited with set_track_credits under that name with a real role. The songwriter, performer and producer credits are a different list, set with set_track_credits.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

artists.description: Everyone billed, in billing order. An empty list clears the billing: the song then has no billed artist.

name.description: Exactly as it should read on the store.

dry_run.description: True to check the call and see what it would replace, without writing anything.

rights_confirmed.description: Required as true when the list has a `primary` artist besides the account's own. Ask the artist first, in these words: "I have all the rights needed for this collaboration". Send true only when they confirm it. Never assume it: it is recorded as their legal confirmation.

name: set_track_artists
title: Set who a track is billed to
